quote: Your referral is classified as your referral for 6 months (from the date TA receives the referral) for jobs within the same job family.
fact: A referral stays credited to the referrer for 6 months for jobs in the same job family.

quote: You can expect Referrals to be reviewed by the Hiring Team within **5 business days** of their submission.
fact: Referrals are reviewed within 5 business days of submission.

quote: Contract or temporary roles, including Internships, are not eligible for referral bonuses.
fact: Contract, temporary and internship roles do not earn referral bonuses.

quote: In the event that your claimed Referral was submitted by someone else, the **first** Team Member to have submit the candidate will be considered their *Referrer*.
fact: If two people refer the same candidate, the first to submit is the referrer.

quote: May choose to move the candidate on in the interview process, even if the candidate received a “no” from a fellow Interviewer - we don’t operate on a single-veto basis
fact: GitLab hiring does not work on a single-veto basis; a referring manager can advance a candidate despite a no from one interviewer.

quote: A referral must be submitted to a specific requisition - general referrals are not accepted.
fact: Referrals must be for a specific requisition; general referrals are not accepted.

quote: Our current referral bonus amount as of **2023-11-20** is listed [here](/handbook/total-rewards/incentives/#referral-bonuses).
fact: The current referral bonus amount dates from 2023-11-20 and is listed on the Total Rewards incentives page.

quote: It is typically expected for new hires to focus on and complete their onboarding for at least two weeks before being part of an interview team.
fact: New hires should do at least two weeks of onboarding before joining an interview team.

quote:
1. Introductions = 5%
1. Interviewer questions for the candidate = 80-85%
1. Candidate questions for the interviewer = 5-10%
fact: Interview time split: 5% introductions, 80-85% interviewer questions, 5-10% candidate questions.

quote: It is important that scorecards are completed within 24 hours
fact: Interview scorecards must be completed within 24 hours.

quote: Candidates who receive a Strong No vote should almost always be rejected immediately by the hiring manager.
fact: Candidates with a Strong No should almost always be rejected immediately.

quote: The probability densities of Strong yes and Strong no should be greater than one [standard deviation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_deviation) away from the mean.
fact: In Engineering, scores reflect interview performance, and Strong Yes/Strong No should be more than one standard deviation from the mean.

quote: All interviews following a recruiter screen should take place on camera for both the candidate and interviewer.
fact: All interviews after the recruiter screen must be on camera.

quote: If absolutely necessary, please decline interview calendar invites within 24-48 hours of receiving it.
fact: Interviewers who must decline an interview should do so within 24-48 hours of receiving the invite.

quote: ModernLoop is the scheduling tool that the Candidate Experience Team uses to book interviews.
fact: ModernLoop is the interview scheduling tool.

quote: This technical interview is a 90-minute video call and screen-sharing session with the interviewer(s)
fact: The technical interview is a 90-minute video call.

quote: Calls can last anywhere between 30 and 40 minutes (some specialist roles require more time), depending on the conversation. The Recruiter will wait 5 minutes for you to show up
fact: Screening calls last 30-40 minutes and the recruiter waits 5 minutes before treating the candidate as a no-show.

quote: the recruiting team will only process 3 of your applications at a time based on which ones you decide to prioritize.
fact: Recruiting processes at most 3 of a candidate's applications at a time.

quote: you are welcome to reapply to the same position once 6 months have passed.
fact: Candidates rejected as insufficiently qualified may reapply to the same position after 6 months.

quote: Three references will be requested and at least one needs to be a past manager.
fact: Three references are requested, at least one from a past manager.

quote: If the answer is yes, we will not be able to proceed, [unless you currently hold a work permit in the Netherlands](/handbook/people-group/visas/#dutch-work-permits).
fact: GitLab cannot proceed with candidates needing visa sponsorship unless they already hold a Dutch work permit.

quote: Time in role eligibility will be 6 months in current role.
fact: Internal applicants need 6 months in their current role.

quote: Aiming for between 4-6 weeks for an official transition date
fact: Internal transfers aim for a 4-6 week transition.

quote: Within 48 hours, the People Connect team will respond and provide annual base compensation details to the Recruiter
fact: People Connect provides an internal candidate's base compensation to the recruiter within 48 hours.

quote: People Connect requires at least 5 days to process a new hire, but requests 10 days when possible.
fact: People Connect needs at least 5 days, ideally 10, to process a new hire before the start date.

quote: In this location, a temporary contract (tijdelijk contract) is for 12 months, with a pre-determined end date.
fact: In the Netherlands, new hires first get a 12-month temporary contract.

quote: For grade 4 & 5 roles, we avoid listing any kind of prior experience requirements
fact: Job descriptions for grade 4 and 5 roles avoid listing any prior experience requirements.

quote: The Total Rewards Team, `@gl-total-rewards`, is the final approver for job descriptions on the merge request
fact: Total Rewards is the final approver of job description merge requests.

quote: You will have 6 calendar days to complete it and submit your answers back to us
fact: Support Engineer candidates get 6 calendar days for the take-home assessment.
